title: librarian
owner: CC (code+proofs); Akien (design: the face, the verbs, the library, the parts inventory; disposition of what the librarian learns into the intention layer)
intention: The librarian as a device — db_domain's first real tenant and the owner of the graph trees. FIRST FACE (the current goal): a chatbot — learning always, summarizing when asked. A query resolves by traversing the trees (cheap, no inference); on a MISS the LLM is asked for the NODES that let the graph resolve — never the answer — so the answer always comes from structure and re-asking is a graph walk, not a second inference. Law 1 as a runtime mechanism.
why: Akien, 2026-07-27, verbatim: 'the current goal is the librarian as chat bot, learning, and summarizing. learning always and summarizing when asked' ... 'in future we can ask the librarian to spend a few days researching a topic ... and it can come back with a summary that we can also ask deeper questions from. And he'll already be ready to answer them immediately. This is part of orienting, for anything externally facing.' Same day, the frame: 'the goal is only improving CC not hiding it yet' — the cocoon stays distant; the librarian improves CC, it does not wrap it. The full design record: CairnCommons/notes/held-librarian.json (his parts inventory, the LIBRARY room at the RATIFIED address ~/.cairn/devices/librarian/0/library/, the three verbs: learn / learn+summarize / learn+summarize-by-X-time).
traces_to: Law 1 — the core loop IS the law as runtime: every answered question becomes structure; the settled resolves by walk, the resolver is spent only on the novel
Law 3 — a node provided by the LLM is a hypothesis at birth; it earns tenure the way probes do
Law 6 — the librarian OWNS the graph trees; db_domain's owner-gate is the physics under every write
telos aim 1 (inference compilation) and aim 4 (think like Akien) — every /sorted has been one distillation by hand; this device is that move, compiled
memory: librarian-graph-tree-thread (the settled design facts); cocoon-settle-stages-around-cc (what this is NOT sprinting toward)

falsifier.proves_green: each child stone carries its own proof gate; the parent's PROVEME is the composed face: a question answered from structure, a MISS folded in, a re-ask resolving by walk alone. MEASURED 2026-07-27 through the live chat surface (browser door, library tree): the audit-agent question answered from structure at 0.6772 with ZERO backfills (a walk over nodes earlier crossings folded in — the re-ask-by-walk clause, across sessions); the payback-meter question MISSED, backfilled 3 nodes, and the original question resolved through them (the miss-folded-in clause); the summarize: turn rendered cited prose that landed back as structure. All three clauses green in one conversation.
falsifier.proves_red: wrong-shape signals: answers coming from inference when the graph already holds the structure (the core loop bypassed — a chatbot wearing a librarian's charter); the graph growing without provenance (nodes nobody can trace — fabricated attribution at deposit scale); the summary becoming a document the graph forgets (the transducer detached from the trees).
falsifier.horizon: the ratified chain is closed (all five stones PROVED 2026-07-27). Re-read when Akien names the next pull — the leading candidates carried by the children's filed edges: the TENURE LOOP (charter edge l now has two measured whys + a cross-tree question), the proactive research face (assignment/desk), the outbound door (edge e), the by-time verb — or when held-librarian's held sections change under it.

questions.a: BUILT STONE-WISE ON A RATIFIED CHAIN: Akien ratified the dependency ordering 2026-07-27 ('yes! go go go!') — graph-tree store first (zero unmet dependencies), then the core loop (fixing the backfill-cache livelock as it goes live), then learn + first acquisition (shelving TheIgorsProject/Akien), then summarize (the transducer), then the chat surface (web_server standing by).

THE EMBEDS-GENERATOR PART GOT THINNER: inference_domain already carries the embed seam (/api/embed, metered, cached) — the domain returns vectors as a service and the librarian writes its own trees AS OWNER. db_domain's delegated-access edge is NOT on the critical path; it opens when a genuinely different owner needs in.

CC's four parts-inventory additions (assignment, outbound door, provenance-on-deposit, embeddings generator named separately) were OFFERED 2026-07-27; provenance-on-deposit entered the ratified chain via the go-ahead on stone one; the others still await item-by-item confirmation.
